svg.title: Selecting an Architectural Pattern
svg.desc: Decision: can the steps be fully specified in advance? Yes, as a single step: use an Augmented LLM, a single call enhanced with retrieval, tools and memory. Yes, as a fixed multi-step sequence: use a Workflow, where the developer fixes the sequence; sub-patterns are chaining, routing, parallel, orchestrator-workers and evaluator-optimizer. No, the steps depend on what is discovered: use an Agentic System, where the model decides the sequence at runtime.
svg.text: One question decides the tier: can the steps be fully specified in advance?
